summary: For every 0<delta<=1, iid cap-one uniforms H,Y,X give R_delta=Y^2+2delta HY+2HX-X^2/delta^2=(Y+delta H)^2-(delta H-X/delta)^2 with p_R(s)>=(delta/2)log(1/(16|s|)) for 0<|s|<1/16, hence unbounded density. Its matrix has rank two and its two nonzero eigenvalues both have absolute value >1. Therefore the infinitesimal square-carrier-overlap branch cannot be closed by conditioning away the third curvature and seeking a uniform two-variable density receiver. Adding an independent cap-one Z^2 makes an exact three-large-eigenvalue target family; QFORM-RANK2-INDEPENDENT-SQUARE-BRIDGE-v1 yields ||p||_infinity<=128(delta^2+1+delta^-2)^(-1/4)<=128*3^(-1/4)<97.259 and a continuous C_0 density. This is not a counterexample to full QFORM.
